title: Barry W NDE 721
content:
Later, when someone asked me (before the memories of the accident returned clearly), what time of day it was when the accident occurred; I told them I thought it was during the day, because I was in a bubble of what appeared to be sunlight. It was only later that I recalled that I had left Denny's just before 9:000 p.m. I remained conscious until I was in the emergency room. I was unconscious for the next day and a half, only awakening once when I realized that I was suffocating to death. I was immediately taken up into a black void, where I began to see what I somehow instinctively knew were beings that had once been human. They were all composed of a condensed group of rainbow colored lights, but nothing that in any way appeared human. I could feel their thoughts like a cool breeze passing right through me. My own identity appeared to also be composed of light, I noticed that my light had the ability to reach anywhere I wanted, and whatever beam of light consciousness I chose to direct my attention to, I could instantly travel down. I did this and found myself in a floral shop. What I found extremely fascinating was that I was able to experience all of the flowers simultaneously, and that no matter where I went I was always at the center of everything!

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Immediately taken up into a black void.

arrival.other_being_detail: Beings 'that had once been human' composed of 'a condensed group of rainbow colored lights' with thoughts felt 'like a cool breeze passing right through me.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Black void; later a floral shop; experiencer also described being 'in a bubble of what appeared to be sunlight.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Travel by directing a 'beam of light consciousness' and instantly arriving (e.g., in a floral shop); 'bubble of what appeared to be sunlight.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Black void with beings; then intentional travel to an earthly location (floral shop).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported experiencing 'all of the flowers simultaneously' and being 'always at the center of everything.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived being in a 'bubble of what appeared to be sunlight' despite later recalling the accident occurred around 9:00 p.m.; beings as non-human shapes made of condensed rainbow lights; travel by focusing a 'beam of light consciousness'; simultaneous perception of all flowers while always being at the center.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was immediately taken up into a black void"; "They were all composed of a condensed group of rainbow colored lights"; "I could feel their thoughts like a cool breeze passing right through me"; "whatever beam of light consciousness I chose to direct my attention to, I could instantly travel down"; "I was able to experience all of the flowers simultaneously"; "I was always at the center of everything!"
